segments.title: Broadcast Sign-On and Hype Train Activation
segments.notes: Pepito delivers cold open; Hype Train suffers audio issues before launching into freestyle acknowledgments of subscribers and bit donors.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle and Subscriber Roll Call
segments.notes: Hype Train raps over a 'terrible trap beat' while thanking Uncle Phil 2K, Skymer, Waco's Art, Xander, Brundle Sprout, and S1000; discusses spawn-like nature of Hype Train's existence.

segments.title: Post-Hype Train Desk Banter
segments.notes: Case and Pepito exchange profanity-laden banter; Pepito reveals he has been hanging out with Chet and picked up his vocabulary.

segments.title: Biden NATO Speech and Press Briefing Coverage
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins to cover White House press briefing on Biden's neurologist visits, Biden's NATO speech awarding Medal of Freedom to Jens Stoltenberg, and debate over Biden's mental fitness; Ripple signs off with 'Biden time' pun.

segments.title: Kendall Call-In and Wiki Feet Investigation
segments.notes: Kendall calls in on speakerphone; chat discovers a wikiFeet page for her; Case runs a flash poll to identify the creator; Kendall denies involvement.

segments.title: Viral Video Review: Plane Deaths, Raw Dogging Flights, Airport Restaurants, Bubble Song, Trump Hannibal Lecter, Joe Rogan/Miley Cyrus, Prison Loaf, Giant Worm Animation, National Treasure Supercut
segments.notes: Scrum co-hosts; videos rated on 1-10 scale; highlights include raw dogging flight trend, eight-minute bubble song, Trump's Hannibal Lecter rant (Vic Berger supercut), and giant worm AI animation.

segments.title: Kendall Arrives In-Studio
segments.notes: Kendall walks through frame; brief discussion of sketch controversy and wikiFeet page; flash poll results tie between chat and Crum.

segments.title: Kendall In-Studio Banter and Wiki Feet Aftermath
segments.notes: Kendall discusses foot tattoo, wikiFeet ratings, Kevin's feet, and potential streaming setup; Case mentions CASM assets and call-in show assets in development.

segments.title: Movie Trailers with Trent and Chris
segments.notes: Trent and Chris review trailers for Gladiator II, Louis C.K. documentary 'Sorry Not Sorry', Emmanuel erotic film, and Kite Man animated series; discuss DC universe and Louis C.K. controversy.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Experience Parody: Moose Noises, Flat Earth, Hannibal Lecter, Toad-Licking Biden Fantasy
segments.notes: Case and AI Joe Rogan discuss moose interview strategy, earth shape agnosticism, Trump's Hannibal Lecter obsession, and a graphic fantasy of licking toads and spitting into Biden's mouth to cure his dryness.

segments.title: Charlie Pellet Interview and Raid to Ricky Peacock
segments.notes: Case interviews Charlie Pellet, voice of NYC subway, via a Bloomberg profile video; Pellet delivers sign-off from his country farm; raid initiated to Ricky Peacock with Pellet attempting a subway-themed rap.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors full broadcast; manages Hype Train technical issues, conducts Biden news desk, runs wikiFeet flash poll, hosts Amongst the Web with Scrum, interviews Charlie Pellet.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open; engages in profane banter with Case; reveals exposure to Chet's vocabulary.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Executes subscriber/bit acknowledgments via freestyle rap over broken beats; discusses metaphysical spawn-like existence.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers Biden coverage including press briefing neurologist exchange and NATO speech; debates Biden's mental fitness with Case.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in on speakerphone, then appears in-studio; subject of wikiFeet page investigation; discusses foot tattoo and streaming plans.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts movie trailer segment from theater with Chris; reviews Gladiator II, Louis C.K., Emmanuel, Kite Man.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: field correspondent. Accompanies Trent as 'sprawl officer'; comments on trailers and DC universe.

characters.name: Joe Rogan
characters.notes: call-in guest. AI parody joins for The Jo Rogen Experience; discusses moose noises, flat earth, Hannibal Lecter, and toad-licking Biden fantasy.

lore_notes.fact: Has a wikiFeet page created by an unknown party (chat suspects Eldrick); page features a single photo from Instagram showing her foot tattoo.
Owns a Charlie Pellet (NYC subway voice) sound pellet.
Developing CASM assets and call-in show assets for Kendall's future streaming setup.
References Reverend Wolf's prophecy that 'Fiona will never come back and I'll never move.'
Is the long-time voice of the NYC subway system; currently resides at a country farm; loves farming; hates North Dakota (prefers one Dakota).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers Biden's NATO appearance and neurologist press briefing before pivoting to a wikiFeet investigation targeting Kendall. The Amongst the Web segment reviews viral videos including raw-dogging flights, an eight-minute bubble song, and Trump's Hannibal Lecter obsession. The broadcast closes with movie trailers, a Joe Rogan parody featuring a toad-licking Biden fantasy, and a raid to Ricky Peacock led by NYC subway voice Charlie Pellet.
